answer: In this PoA design, each challenge commits to a verifier-defined task and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose unpredictable, publicly verifiable output derives the final instance and scoring salt. Until that pulse arrives, an automated swarm cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline, while duplicating identities provides no advantage. An ember, ripple, or umber label is merely metadata, not entropy, so only timely, verifiable participation earns weight.
